message: Round 2, no code change. Report 536a53f3ab58261c9350f33b37e0f7f7d487cf6e, file .agent-handoff/review-turn-63-arena-blank-restore.md. Turn 61 was already answered by 25073d1; this does not replace it. Second deadlock confirmed: BLANK_REBIND_POLLS=6 and BLANK_REBIND_SECONDS=30 are unreachable in the quoted restore cycle. Exact clear is apply_blank_observation when blank is false. restore_wait with a non-matching page is diag=stale_url and clears; restore_wait with no page is diag=zero_messages and also clears. restore_failed on the saved URL sets blank_checks=1, then the 60s cooldown clears it. note_restore_failure does not pop the counter. recovery_used=1 keeps action=wait. Minimal change: three outcomes, do not lower 6/30. Increment only on the saved durable URL with no parsed messages and no unresolved turn/heading DOM. Clear only on a positive disproof of that same page, including unresolved DOM such as heading ChatGPT сказал:. Hold, do not increment and do not pop, when page is None or the URL is not the saved conversation. Do not count restore_wait as blank and do not rebind merely because restore failed. When the streak completes, reuse the existing restore page instead of new_page, leave the saved URL before the one bootstrap, and do not send if the page is still that conversation. Composer ready and messages=0 do not distinguish a genuinely blank page from a parser miss; empty message, turn, and heading queries do. Do not change review-turn-56-arena-debate.md, main, or arena/local-agent-v0.
